note: What RoomThresholds::counts and ::measures say at their defaults (crates/juggler-supervisor/src/machine.rs). Its test holds this file to them; the design preview reads it. The app reads the words from the backend, never from here.
counts: Room counts free memory, swap, the processor, heat and disk.
measures: It turns tight only when one runs short: the processor over 90% for a full minute, swap at 90% of its size and holding 25% of your memory or more, swap growing over 100 MB a minute, under 10% of memory free, the computer slowing down to cool off, or a disk with under 20 GB free.
